Regions / Ethics and Impacts

Ethics and Impacts

Coming soon

At the center of the map, where every road meets. Students examine how computing affects individuals, communities, and society.

Topics

  • Bias and fairness
  • Privacy and surveillance
  • Accessibility
  • Computing and society
  • Responsible design
Find it on the map

Activity ideas

Unplugged ideas for each topic, to be written up as full activities.

  • The Fair Rule · Bias and fairness

    Groups write a rule for choosing who gets a limited prize, test it on a deck of applicant cards, and find who the rule leaves out.

  • Where Do You Stand? · Privacy and surveillance

    Students stand along a line from agree to disagree on data scenarios, explain their positions, and look for what would change their minds.

  • Design for Everyone · Accessibility

    Using user persona cards, groups redesign a paper app screen so each persona can use it.

  • Futures Wheel · Computing and society

    Starting from a new technology, students draw rings of first, second, and third effects on chart paper.

  • Town Hall · Responsible design

    Students take stakeholder role cards and debate whether their town should adopt an algorithm, such as one that schedules buses.

Activities

Full activities for this region are being written. Each will be unplugged, with a teacher guide and print-ready handouts, and students will need no technology.
